title: Paste the link. Bring the film straight in.
description: Click “+”, paste a public link, then choose “Download.” The film and its source details land together in your library.

title: One film. Every cut, mapped.
description: Choose “Scene Mode” to detect every cut automatically. Jump to the previous or next edit with ↑ / ↓.

title: Keep the exact frame you stop on.
description: Choose “Save Frame” (E) to preserve the current image with its source and exact timecode.

title: Take exactly the sound you need.
description: Set In (I) and Out (O), then choose “Export Audio Range” (P) to create the clip.

title: Transcribe locally. Stay in sync.
description: Choose “Generate Subtitles” to transcribe on your Mac, with every line locked to playback.

title: Your storyboard, ready in one step.
description: Choose “Export Storyboard” to organize shot numbers, timecodes, frames, and subtitles into one ready-to-use table.

title: Your selects, ready to drag anywhere.
description: Select and drag frames, audio, or music straight into your editing software.

title: Find the music behind the film.
description: Open the “Music” tab to identify tracks and reveal the matching moments in the film.
